svg.aria-label: The Business Equation: four overlapping systems - Engagement (growth), Record (compliance), Production and Commerce - around the Business Equation of Market and Organisation. People, Money and Things enter as the Offer and leave as Value, the Shift Enabled, as power moves from Producer Efficient Supply Chains to Customer Effective Demand Networks.
svg.title: The Business Equation
